name: al-gabas-store-android
description: Al Gabas Store accounting app Android wrapper

scripts.build:android: mkdir -p www && cp -R accounting/. www/ && cp config.js www/config.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:desktop: rm -rf desktop-dist && mkdir -p desktop-dist/accounting && cp -R accounting/. desktop-dist/accounting/ && cp config.js desktop-dist/config.js && printf '%s\n' '<!doctype html><html lang="ar" dir="rtl"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0;url=accounting/"><title>AG System</title><body>جاري تشغيل AG System...</body></html>' > desktop-dist/index.html
